topic: Getting an Estimate for a Repair

script.title: AT THE WASHING MACHINE
script.story_hook: A leaking washer needs a real estimate.
script.intro_zh: 一台漏水洗衣機，等一份可靠的報價。
script.welcome_en: Welcome! Today a broken washer gets an estimate. Listen for parts and price phrases.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎！今天我們請人估價修洗衣機。留意零件與費用的說法。
script.outro: Signed estimate, dry floor. See you next time!
script.outro_zh: 估價單簽了，地板也乾了。下次再見！
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each repair phrase.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在，我們逐句跟讀維修報價的常用說法。
script.char_a_description: a man in his forties with a thin mustache and close-cut brown hair, wearing a striped flannel shirt, work pants and rubber boots, broad shoulders, holding a flashlight
script.char_b_description: a woman in her thirties with black hair tucked under a dark cap, wearing a navy mechanic vest over a plaid shirt, cargo pants and steel-toe boots, a tool belt at her hip

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks for coming out. It leaks everywhere.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks fɔɹ ˈkʌmɪŋ aʊt ɪt liːks ˈɛvɹiˌwɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你特地跑一趟。它弄得地上到處是水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No problem. Where does the water start?
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈpɹɑbləm wɛɹ dʌz ðə ˈwɔɾɚ stɑɹt/
dialogue.zh: 不客氣。水是從哪裡開始漏的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See this puddle? Right under the door seal.
dialogue.phonetic: /si ðɪs ˈpʌdl̩ ɹaɪt ˈʌndɚ ðə dɔɹ sil/
dialogue.zh: 看這攤水，就從門邊的密封圈下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay. Flashlight on… hmm, the front gasket.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ˈflæʃˌlaɪt ɑn hʌm ðə fɹʌnt ˈɡæskɪt/
dialogue.zh: 好。手電筒打開……嗯，是前面的橡皮封條。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that the rubber ring around the glass?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt ðə ˈɹʌbɚ ɹɪŋ əˈɹaʊnd ðə ɡlæs/
dialogue.zh: 你說的是玻璃那一圈橡膠環嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly. It leaks when it's cracked.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli ɪt liːks wɛn ɪts kɹækt/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，它一有裂縫就會滲水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mine has one small split, right there.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn hæz wʌn smɑl splɪt ɹaɪt ðɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 我這條正好有一小個裂口，就在那兒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yup, I see it. That's suspect number one.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʌp aɪ si ɪt ðæts sʌsˈpɛkt ˈnʌmbɚ wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 看到了，它就是第一嫌疑犯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Suspect number one? What's number two?
dialogue.phonetic: /sʌsˈpɛkt ˈnʌmbɚ wʌn wʌts ˈnʌmbɚ tu/
dialogue.zh: 第一嫌疑犯？那第二個是誰？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The pump. Let me peek behind the panel.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə pʌm pɛt mi pik bɪˈhaɪnd ðə ˈpænl̩/
dialogue.zh: 是排水幫浦。讓我看看面板後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That panel screws off? Handy, huh.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈpænl̩ skɹuz ɑf ˈhændi hʌ/
dialogue.zh: 那塊板轉開螺絲就能拆？真方便。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four screws… and — oh, look at this.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔɹ skɹuz ænd oʊ lʊk æt ðɪs/
dialogue.zh: 四顆螺絲……噢，你來看這個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What? Is it bad? You're quiet.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪz ɪt bæd jʊɹ ˈkwaɪət/
dialogue.zh: 怎麼了？很嚴重嗎？你都不說話了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A hairpin, a coin, and one small sock.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈhɛɹpɪn ə kɔɪn ænd wʌn smɑl sɑk/
dialogue.zh: 一根髮夾、一枚硬幣，還有隻小襪子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A sock! My kids lose those constantly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə sɑk maɪ kɪdz luz ðoʊz ˈkɑnstəntli/
dialogue.zh: 襪子！我家小孩老是弄丟那種。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Classic. The pump's half-blocked, see the crust?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈklæsɪk ðə pʊmz hæf blɑktd si ðə kɹʌst/
dialogue.zh: 經典場面。幫浦堵了一半，看到那些垢了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So — the ring and the pump? Two jobs?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðə ɹɪŋ ænd ðə pʌm tu dʒɑbz/
dialogue.zh: 所以——封條和幫浦，是兩個工？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One part is dirty, one is cracked.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn pɑɹt ɪz ˈdɜɹti wʌn ɪz kɹækt/
dialogue.zh: 一個零件是髒的，一個是裂的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you clean the dirty one today?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju klin ðə ˈdɜɹti wʌn təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那髒的這個，你今天能先清理嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can, but the pump part's on order.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kæn bʌt ðə pʌm pɑɹts ɑn ˈɔɹdɚ/
dialogue.zh: 可以，但幫浦的零件是訂購中的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: On order? How long till it arrives?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn ˈɔɹdɚ haʊ lɔŋ tɪl ɪt əˈɹaɪvz/
dialogue.zh: 訂購中？那要幾天才會到？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thursday, if shipping holds. Usually does.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɜɹzˌdeɪ ɪf ˈʃɪpɪŋ hoʊldz ˈjuʒəwəli dʌz/
dialogue.zh: 週四就到，貨運不延誤的話。通常都會到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay. And the big question — what's the damage?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ænd ðə bɪɡ ˈkwɛstʃən wʌts ðə ˈdæmɪdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 好。然後那個大問題——總共要多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Parts and labor, let me break it down.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɑɹts ænd ˈleɪbɚ lɛt mi breɪk ɪt daʊn/
dialogue.zh: 零件加工資，我一項一項拆給你聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes please. I love a clear breakdown.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs pliz aɪ lʌv ə klɪɹ ˈbɹeɪkˌdaʊn/
dialogue.zh: 麻煩你了，我最愛聽清楚的明細。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Gasket is thirty, the pump is sixty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɡæskɪt ɪz ˈθɜɹti ðə pʌm ɪz ˈsɪksti/
dialogue.zh: 密封圈三十，幫浦零件六十。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's ninety in parts. Labor is extra?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ˈnɪnti ɪn pɑɹts ˈleɪbɚ ɪz ˈɛkstɚ/
dialogue.zh: 零件共九十，工資另算嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Labor is ninety flat, two hours' work.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈleɪbɚ ɪz ˈnɪnti flæt tu ˈaʊɚz wɜɹk/
dialogue.zh: 工資固定九十，對應兩小時工時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So the full estimate is one-eighty?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðə fʊl ˈɛstəmət ɪz wʌn ˈæɾi/
dialogue.zh: 也就是說，整張估價是一百八十？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One eighty, plus tax. Written, no surprises.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈæɾi plʌs tæks ˈɹɪtn noʊ sɚˈpɹaɪzəz/
dialogue.zh: 一百八十，外加稅。白紙黑字，不會加錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That beats my guess. I feared two-fifty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt bits maɪ ɡɛs aɪ fɪɹd tu ˈfɪfti/
dialogue.zh: 這比我猜的便宜，我以為要兩百五。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two-fifty is normal for a dryer job.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈfɪfti ɪz ˈnɔɹməl fɔɹ ə dɹaɪɚ dʒɑb/
dialogue.zh: 兩百五是烘衣機修繕的行情。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good to know. Any cheaper option today?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd tə noʊ ˈɛni ˈtʃipɚ ˈɑpʃən təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 長見識了。那今天有便宜一點的選項嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There's one: clean the pump, skip the gasket.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛɹz wʌn klin ðə pʌm skɪp ðə ˈɡæskɪt/
dialogue.zh: 有一個：只清幫浦，暫不換密封圈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then the ring could leak again soon.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðə ɹɪŋ kʊd liːk əˈɡɛn sun/
dialogue.zh: 那樣封條可能很快又開始滲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Could. Six-month risk, and it's your call.
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd sɪks mʌnθ ɹɪsk ænd ɪts jʊɹ kɔl/
dialogue.zh: 是有風險，撐半年不一定，你來決定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's do the full repair. I hate revisits.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts du ðə fʊl ɹɪˈpɛɹ aɪ heɹt ɹiˈvɪzɪts/
dialogue.zh: 還是整修一次到位吧，我討厭跑兩趟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart. Same thing I'd tell my mother.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑɹt seɪm θɪŋ aɪd tɛl maɪ ˈmʌðɚ/
dialogue.zh: 聰明。這話我也是這樣跟我媽說的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha! Does the warranty cover any of this?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ dʌz ðə ˈwɔɹənti ˈkʌvɚ ˈɛnɪ ʌv ðɪs/
dialogue.zh: 哈！保固能不能涵蓋其中幾項？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's out, sorry. The machine's past four years.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts aʊt ˈsɑɹi ðə məˈʃinz pæst fɔɹ jɪɹz/
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，早就出保固了。這台機器超過四年了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Five years old, and we bought it used.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts faɪv oʊld ænd wi bɔt ɪt juzd/
dialogue.zh: 它五歲了，而且是買二手的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then yes, definitely out of warranty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn jɛs ˈdɛfənətli aʊt ʌv ˈwɔɹənti/
dialogue.zh: 那就肯定不在保固裡了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fine. Can I hold Thursday morning for you?
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪn kæn aɪ hoʊld ˈθɜɹzˌdeɪ ˈmɔɹnɪŋ fɔɹ ju/
dialogue.zh: 好。那我可以先保留週四上午的時段嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eight to noon works. Anyone home is enough.
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪt tə nun wɜɹks ˈɛnɪˌwʌn hoʊm ɪz ɪˈnʌf/
dialogue.zh: 八點到中午都行，家裡有人就好辦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll clear this corner for your tools.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl klɪɹ ðɪs ˈkɔɹnɚ fɔɹ jʊɹ tuːlz/
dialogue.zh: 我會把這個角落清出來給你擺工具。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great. And stop using the machine after today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt ænd stɑp ˈjuzɪŋ ðə məˈʃin ˈæftɚ təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。然後今天起先別再洗衣服了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No more laundry at all? Ouch.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ mɔɹ ˈlɔndɹi ɔt ɑl aʊtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 完全不能洗衣？這下可傷腦筋了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The laundromat's four blocks east, on Elm.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈlɑndɹəˌmætz fɔɹ blɑks ist ɑn ɛm/
dialogue.zh: 往東四個街口有家自助洗衣店，在榆樹街。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I know the place. Their coffee is sad.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ noʊ ðə pleɪs ðɛɹ ˈkɔfi ɪz sæd/
dialogue.zh: 我知道那家店。他們的咖啡很糟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! Bad coffee, clean machines, that's the deal.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ bæd ˈkɔfi klin məˈʃinɪz ðæts ðə dil/
dialogue.zh: 哈！咖啡難喝但機子乾淨，就是那兒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay. One more thing — that hose, is it okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ wʌn mɔɹ θɪŋ ðæt hoʊz ɪz ɪt oʊˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 好。還有一件事——那根水管沒問題吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me check… tight enough, it's not the leak.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi tʃɛk taɪt ɪˈnʌf ɪts nɑt ðə liːk/
dialogue.zh: 我看看……夠緊，漏水不是從它來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So the hose is innocent. Good to rule out.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðə hoʊz ɪz ˈɪnəsənt ɡʊd tə ɹul aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 那水管是無辜的。排除一項真好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's what a second look is for.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts wʌt ə ˈsɛkənd lʊk ɪz fɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 多看一眼，就是為這種時候。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You even checked without me asking. Respect.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ˈivɪn tʃɛkt wɪˈðaʊt mi ˈæskɪŋ ɹɪˈspɛkt/
dialogue.zh: 你不等我開口就檢查了，實在專業。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's written on the estimate, signed right here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈɹɪtn ɑn ði ˈɛstəmət saɪnd ɹaɪt hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 都寫在估價單上了，請在這裡簽名。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done. Oh, and the junk from the pump?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn oʊ ænd ðə dʒʌŋk fɹʌm ðə pʌm/
dialogue.zh: 簽好了。對了，從幫浦清出來的垃圾呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bagged, right on top of the washer.
dialogue.phonetic: /bæɡd ɹaɪt ɑn tɑp ʌv ðə ˈwɑʃɚ/
dialogue.zh: 裝進袋子了，就擺在洗衣機最上面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The sock goes home with the kids. Bye Thursday!
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə sɑk ɡoʊz hoʊm wɪð ðə kɪdz baɪ ˈθɜɹzˌdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那襪子跟我小孩回家囉。週四見，拜拜！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bye! Text me if the puddle grows before then.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ tɛkst mi ɪf ðə ˈpʌdl̩ ɡɹoʊz bɪˈfɔɹ ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 拜拜！提前又漏大的話，傳訊息找我。

script.youtube_title: 【🔧「總共要多少錢？」】🎧60句維修估價聽力實境｜密封圈破裂・幫浦堵塞・工資明細｜💡不用背多聽就會用｜🌱A2｜Getting an Estimate for a Repair
script.youtube_title_en: "What's the Damage?" — Getting an Estimate for a Repair
script.youtube_description:
60句維修估價聽力練習：洗衣機漏成一攤水，師傅上門檢查，從密封圈查到幫浦，一份清清楚楚的報價怎麼聽、怎麼問？

這一集跟著一位家長，看維修技術員擰開面板、清出發夾和襪子，學會零件與工資的拆細講法、訂購零件的等待時間、保固是否涵蓋，還有怎麼選今天小修或一次修好。

你會聽到：
- 請師傅報價的開口句：「What's the damage?」
- 拆明細的說法：「Parts and labor, let me break it down.」
- 零件與風險的討論：「Six-month risk, and it's your call.」
- 預約時段與後續注意事項

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，把這些句子聽熟、說順。

script.youtube_description_en:
60 lines of repair-estimate listening practice: a washing machine leaks across the laundry room floor, and the technician finds a cracked door gasket plus a pump full of hairpins, coins and one small sock.

You will hear how to describe the problem, ask what's the damage, compare parts with labor, weigh a cheaper today-fix against the full repair, check the warranty, and book the part's arrival day. The second half is line-by-line listening and shadowing.

Made for A2 learners: no memorizing, just listen until it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for daily-life English listening videos every week.

script.thumbnail_action: pointing at a puddle on the floor
